card.name: Gram or spoon units before a substance
card.fires_on: The unit word (g, gram, teaspoonful) or the word 'of' right after it, when a measured amount of a substance is being prepared or mixed. Seen in preparation, mixing and application directions.

modes.label: Gram unit after a number
modes.description: The abbreviation g or the word gram directly after a quantity in mixing directions.

modes.label: 'of' after a measure
modes.description: The word 'of' following a unit such as gram or teaspoon, just before the named substance.
